{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Use the existing Spring XD build, dependency-management, module, deployment, and test conventions rather than introducing new build or runtime frameworks.",
    "Implement @EnableModule using Spring configuration/import infrastructure and classpath annotation scanning, with @Input and @Output identifying logical channel endpoints.",
    "Have the framework create channel beans and channel adapters for annotated modules while preserving compatibility with existing explicit channel-bean definitions.",
    "Treat the Ambari high-availability change as a parameterized multi-instance XD-Admin deployment with shared or externally accessible state configured according to the existing Spring XD topology.",
    "Upgrade Reactor through the project dependency-management mechanism and resolve source, binary, and behavioral compatibility issues in affected modules.",
    "Complete Kryo changes using the existing serialization strategy and registration conventions, prioritizing deterministic registration and backward compatibility where persisted or transported data requires it.",
    "Move serialization codec code into Spring Integration as a separately buildable Maven artifact, then update Spring XD to consume it through a normal Maven dependency.",
    "For module installation, prefer Maven coordinates and repository resolution through existing Spring XD CLI and runtime extension points rather than implementing a separate artifact repository protocol.",
    "Implement the CloudController-based XD Admin SPI through the existing ModuleLauncher and Spring Cloud deployer abstractions, isolating Cloud Foundry-specific behavior behind the SPI.",
    "Use automated unit, integration, deployment, and regression tests where practical; document operational configuration and developer-facing usage for each delivered feature."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The relevant Spring XD, Spring Integration, Spring Cloud, Ambari, and CI repositories are available and buildable, and no major unrelated baseline failures consume the estimate.",
    "The work is performed by one experienced Java/Spring developer familiar with the existing codebase; estimates represent person-days of effort, not elapsed calendar time.",
    "Requirements are limited to the eight user stories; no new product-level user interface, extensive migration tooling, or broad API redesign is required.",
    "Existing CI, Maven repository, AWS account, Ambari deployment templates, and Cloud Foundry test access can be obtained without procurement or organizational delays.",
    "The Reactor upgrade targets the stated Reactor 2.0.4 release and includes adapting affected code and tests, but does not include upgrading the entire Spring platform to a newer major generation.",
    "Ambari HA requires configuration and template changes for multiple XD-Admin instances; designing a new distributed coordination or persistence subsystem is out of scope.",
    "The annotation-driven module model must support the common existing module patterns and retain backward compatibility with explicit channel configuration where feasible.",
    "Kryo optimization work is limited to the remaining identified code changes, benchmarks or focused performance checks, regression tests, and documentation; it does not include a comprehensive serialization redesign.",
    "The Maven module-installation story is primarily an investigation and prototype/spike with a documented recommendation and a narrow proof of concept, not a fully hardened enterprise repository service.",
    "The serialization codec extraction preserves its existing behavior and public contracts, with package and dependency changes handled as part of the migration.",
    "The CloudController implementation targets a representative deployer path and testable integration with the referenced Spring Cloud abstractions; production-grade support for every Cloud Foundry version is out of scope.",
    "Documentation and final regression work cover the increment's changed behavior and setup instructions, not a complete rewrite of all Spring XD documentation."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Baseline analysis and implementation planning",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the relevant repositories, branches, build files, existing extension points, test suites, and referenced issue or spike materials; establish dependency and compatibility impact, local build procedure, and an implementation plan for all eight stories.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Reactor 2.0.4 upgrade",
      "activity_description": "Update dependency management to Reactor 2.0.4, compile and repair impacted source code, resolve transitive dependency conflicts, update affected tests, and verify the core Spring XD build and representative runtime paths.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "Ambari multi-instance XD-Admin deployment",
      "activity_description": "Modify Ambari stack, service, configuration, and deployment definitions to support multiple XD-Admin instances; configure instance-specific settings, validate startup and service discovery, and test an HA-oriented deployment and restart scenario.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Annotation-driven module programming model",
      "activity_description": "Design and implement @EnableModule, @Input, and @Output processing; register annotated module configurations, create logical channel beans and channel adapters, handle naming and endpoint wiring, preserve supported explicit configuration behavior, and add unit and integration coverage plus usage documentation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 16
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Remaining Kryo optimizations and guidelines",
      "activity_description": "Review the outstanding Kryo optimization areas, implement serializer and registration improvements, add or update correctness and performance-focused tests, check compatibility assumptions, and document recommended Kryo usage and registration guidelines.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Move the 1.2.x branch CI to EC2",
      "activity_description": "Provision or configure the required EC2-based CI environment, install compatible JDK/build tooling, migrate jobs and credentials/configuration, execute representative and full test suites, and document recovery and maintenance procedures.",
      "most_likely_effort": 7
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Maven-based XD module installation investigation",
      "activity_description": "Investigate repository resolution, CLI artifactId handling, dependency and transitive dependency behavior, runtime module installation mechanisms, security and versioning considerations, and produce a documented design recommendation with a small proof of concept.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Extract serialization codec into Spring Integration",
      "activity_description": "Identify codec ownership and API boundaries, move source and tests into the Spring Integration repository/module, adapt package and build metadata, publish or consume the resulting Maven artifact, update Spring XD dependencies and code, and verify compatibility through integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 12
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "CloudController-based XD Admin SPI",
      "activity_description": "Design and implement the CloudController-backed XD Admin SPI using ModuleLauncher and the referenced Spring Cloud deployer abstractions; map module properties and lifecycle operations, handle deployment status and errors, add mocks or integration tests, and document supported Cloud Foundry configuration.",
      "most_likely_effort": 18
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-feature regression, packaging, and release documentation",
      "activity_description": "Run the complete applicable build and regression suites, investigate and fix integration issues across the dependency, module, deployment, serialization, and infrastructure changes, update release notes and configuration examples, and prepare the increment for review and delivery.",
      "most_likely_effort": 7
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 87
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Use the existing Spring XD build, dependency-management, module, deployment, and test conventions rather than introducing new build or runtime frameworks.
Implement @EnableModule using Spring configuration/import infrastructure and classpath annotation scanning, with @Input and @Output identifying logical channel endpoints.
Have the framework create channel beans and channel adapters for annotated modules while preserving compatibility with existing explicit channel-bean definitions.
Treat the Ambari high-availability change as a parameterized multi-instance XD-Admin deployment with shared or externally accessible state configured according to the existing Spring XD topology.
Upgrade Reactor through the project dependency-management mechanism and resolve source, binary, and behavioral compatibility issues in affected modules.

Complete Kryo changes using the existing serialization strategy and registration conventions, prioritizing deterministic registration and backward compatibility where persisted or transported data requires it.
Move serialization codec code into Spring Integration as a separately buildable Maven artifact, then update Spring XD to consume it through a normal Maven dependency.

For module installation, prefer Maven coordinates and repository resolution through existing Spring XD CLI and runtime extension points rather than implementing a separate artifact repository protocol.
Implement the CloudController-based XD Admin SPI through the existing ModuleLauncher and Spring Cloud deployer abstractions, isolating Cloud Foundry-specific behavior behind the SPI.
Use automated unit, integration, deployment, and regression tests where practical; document operational configuration and developer-facing usage for each delivered feature.
assumptions: The relevant Spring XD, Spring Integration, Spring Cloud, Ambari, and CI repositories are available and buildable, and no major unrelated baseline failures consume the estimate.
The work is performed by one experienced Java/Spring developer familiar with the existing codebase; estimates represent person-days of effort, not elapsed calendar time.
Requirements are limited to the eight user stories; no new product-level user interface, extensive migration tooling, or broad API redesign is required.
Existing CI, Maven repository, AWS account, Ambari deployment templates, and Cloud Foundry test access can be obtained without procurement or organizational delays.
The Reactor upgrade targets the stated Reactor 2.0.4 release and includes adapting affected code and tests, but does not include upgrading the entire Spring platform to a newer major generation.
Ambari HA requires configuration and template changes for multiple XD-Admin instances; designing a new distributed coordination or persistence subsystem is out of scope.
The annotation-driven module model must support the common existing module patterns and retain backward compatibility with explicit channel configuration where feasible.

Kryo optimization work is limited to the remaining identified code changes, benchmarks or focused performance checks, regression tests, and documentation; it does not include a comprehensive serialization redesign.

The Maven module-installation story is primarily an investigation and prototype/spike with a documented recommendation and a narrow proof of concept, not a fully hardened enterprise repository service.
The serialization codec extraction preserves its existing behavior and public contracts, with package and dependency changes handled as part of the migration.

The CloudController implementation targets a representative deployer path and testable integration with the referenced Spring Cloud abstractions; production-grade support for every Cloud Foundry version is out of scope.
Documentation and final regression work cover the increment's changed behavior and setup instructions, not a complete rewrite of all Spring XD documentation.
